source_status: canonical UTF-8 research taxonomy; definitions only; no measured AI competence implied
purpose: Observable general intelligence-entity participation in human civilizational activities, neutral regarding consciousness and subjective experience.

compatibility.relationship: Independent multi-axis supplement; does not replace or sum existing gates

boundaries: No inference of consciousness, sentience, legal personhood or private mental states
No universal AGI/ASI or human-replacement score from a sparse matrix
Authorization and appropriate non-action count as competencies
Capability can be witnessed without granting normative authority
Model, scaffold, memory, tools, deployment, human work and regulatory access must be attributed separately
